Ananya Patel

Experienced Java developer with a track record building resilient backend services and improving system reliability for high-throughput applications. Seeking opportunities to contribute to production-grade systems while transitioning after serving a 90 days notice period.

Java Developer (Hybrid)

- Containerized services with Docker and introduced a standardized image build pipeline, cutting CI-to-deploy time by 35% and enabling reproducible deployments across staging and production.
- Coordinated cross-functional incident responses via Jira and Confluence, authored runbooks for Kafka consumer recovery and led post-incident retrospectives that reduced similar incidents by 40%.

Paystack India, Sep 2023 - Feb 2026
Java Developer (Remote)

- Implemented Docker-based local development environments and optimized container startup times, reducing onboarding time for new engineers by 50% and simplifying integration testing.
- Developed transaction-processing components integrated with message queues, improving throughput by 2.5x while maintaining data consistency across services through careful consumer offset management.
- Managed tasks and release coordination in Jira, documented APIs and operational procedures in Confluence, and maintained source control hygiene using Git.

Projects
- Local Payments Simulator: Built a Dockerized simulator for testing payment failure modes against microservices, enabling QA to reproduce edge-case scenarios and reducing production rollback frequency.
- Kafka Monitoring Dashboard: Implemented a lightweight consumer-lag dashboard using Kafka client metrics to alert on rebalances and lag spikes, cutting mean time to detect pipeline issues by 45%.
